ideas.title: The Feeding Our Future Scandal: Uncovering the Truth Behind the $250 Million Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the Feeding Our Future scheme and the individuals involved, including Abdikerm Eidleh
ideas.angle: Follow the money and uncover the truth behind the scheme
questions: How much money was actually lost?
ideas.insight: I believe that there may be more to the Feeding Our Future scheme than initially meets the eye. By following the money and investigating the individuals involved, we may uncover a larger pattern of fraud and corruption.
